headline: Some days, after a major screw-up, you just want to hit ROLLBACK and pretend it never happened.
caption:
Some days, after a major screw-up, you just want to hit ROLLBACK and pretend it never happened.

—
ROLLBACK: undoes every change made inside a transaction.
